verses.en: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.pt: Israel é vide frondosa que dá o seu fruto; conforme a abundância do seu fruto, assim multiplicou os altares; conforme a prosperidade da terra, assim fizeram belas colunas.
verses.en_web: Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.
verses.en_bbe: Israel is a branching vine, full of fruit; as his fruit is increased, so the number of his altars is increased; as the land is fair, so they have made fair pillars.

verses.en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.pt: O seu coração está dividido, por isso serão culpados; ele derribará os altares deles, e lhes destruirá as colunas.
verses.en_web: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.
verses.en_bbe: Their mind is taken away; now they will be made waste: he will have their altars broken down, he will give their pillars to destruction.

verses.en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
verses.pt: Certamente agora dirão: Não temos rei, porque não tememos ao Senhor; e o rei, que pode ele fazer por nós?
verses.en_web: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”
verses.en_bbe: Now, truly, they will say, We have no king, we have no fear of the Lord; and the king, what is he able to do for us?

verses.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.pt: Falam palavras vãs; juram falsamente, fazendo pactos; por isso brota o juízo como erva peçonhenta nos sulcos dos campos.
verses.en_web: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
verses.en_bbe: Their words are foolish; they make agreements with false oaths, so punishment will come up like a poison-plant in a ploughed field.

verses.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.pt: Os moradores de Samária serão atemorizados por causa do bezerro de Bete-Áven. O seu povo se lamentará por causa dele, como também prantearão os seus sacerdotes idólatras por causa da sua glória, que se apartou dela.
verses.en_web: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven; for its people will mourn over it, Along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.
verses.en_bbe: The people of Samaria will be full of fear because of the ox of Beth-aven; its people will have sorrow for it, and its priests will give cries of grief for its glory, for the glory has gone in flight.

verses.en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.pt: Também será ele levado para Assíria como um presente ao rei Jarebe; Efraim ficará confuso, e Israel se envergonhará por causa do seu próprio conselho.
verses.en_web: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.en_bbe: And they will take it to Assyria and give it to the great king; shame will come on Ephraim, and Israel will be shamed because of its image.

verses.en: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.pt: O rei de Samária será desfeito como a espuma sobre a face da água.
verses.en_web: Samaria and her king float away, like a twig on the water.
verses.en_bbe: As for Samaria, her king is cut off, like mist on the water.

verses.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.pt: E os altos de Áven, pecado de Israel, serão destruídos; espinhos e cardos crescerão sobre os seus altares; e dirão aos montes: Cobri-nos! e aos outeiros: Caí sobre nós!
verses.en_web: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
verses.en_bbe: And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will come to destruction; thorns and waste plants will come up on their altars; they will say to the mountains, Be a cover over us; and to the hills, Come down on us.

verses.en: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.pt: Desde os dias de Gibeá tens pecado, ó Israel; ali permaneceram; a peleja contra os filhos da iniqüidade não os alcançará em Gibeá.
verses.en_web: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.
verses.en_bbe: O Israel, you have done evil from the days of Gibeah; there they took up their position, so that the fighting against the children of evil might not overtake them in Gibeah.

verses.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.pt: Quando eu quiser, castigá-los-ei; e os povos se congregarão contra eles, quando forem castigados pela sua dupla transgressao.
verses.en_web: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.
verses.en_bbe: I will come and give them punishment; and the peoples will come together against them when I give them the reward of their two sins.

verses.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.pt: Porque Efraim era uma novilha domada, que gostava de trilhar; e eu poupava a formosura do seu pescoço; mas porei arreios sobre Efraim; Judá lavrará; Jacó desfará os torrões.
verses.en_web: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.
verses.en_bbe: And Ephraim is a trained cow, taking pleasure in crushing the grain; but I have put a yoke on her fair neck; I will put a horseman on the back of Ephraim; Judah will be working the plough, Jacob will be turning up the earth.

verses.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.pt: Semeai para vós em justiça, colhei segundo a misericórdia; lavrai o campo alqueivado; porque é tempo de buscar ao Senhor, até que venha e chova a justiça sobre vós.
verses.en_web: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
verses.en_bbe: Put in the seed of righteousness, get in your grain in mercy, let your unploughed earth be turned up: for it is time to make search for the Lord, till he comes and sends righteousness on you like rain.

verses.en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.pt: Lavrastes a impiedade, segastes a iniqüidade, e comestes o fruto da mentira; porque confiaste no teu caminho, na multidão dos teus valentes.
verses.en_web: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
verses.en_bbe: You have been ploughing sin, you have got in a store of evil, the fruit of deceit has been your food: for you put faith in your way, in the number of your men of war.

verses.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.pt: Portanto, entre o teu povo se levantará tumulto de guerra, e todas as tuas fortalezas serão destruídas, como Salmã destruiu a Bete-Arbel no dia da batalha; a mãe ali foi despedaçada juntamente com os filhos.
verses.en_web: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
verses.en_bbe: So a great outcry will go up from among your people, and all your strong places will be broken, as Beth-arbel was broken by Shalman in the day of war, as the mother was broken on the rocks with her children.

verses.en: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
verses.pt: Assim vos fará Betel, por causa da vossa grande malícia; de madrugada será o rei de Israel totalmente destruído.
verses.en_web: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.
verses.en_bbe: So will Beth-el do to you because of your evil-doing; at dawn will the king of Israel be cut off completely.
